_meta.description: Names considered and rejected from the Hard Assets Research universe. Each entry documents the reason for exclusion.

excluded.name: Vistra Energy
excluded.reason: AI datacenter power play — already in AI Hardware Research map (datacenter vertical). Boundary rule: reference-only in HA, not double-counted. Primary investment thesis belongs in AI Hardware Research.

excluded.name: Constellation Energy
excluded.reason: Retained in companies list as a nuclear operations reference, but flagged: AI Hardware Research has CEG in its datacenter vertical. Hard Assets version tracks the nuclear fleet angle; do not size it as a HA pure-play.

excluded.name: GE Vernova
excluded.reason: Retained in companies list but: AI Hardware Research has GEV in its datacenter vertical (gas turbines + grid for AI data centers). Hard Assets version tracks the grid supercycle angle. Do not double-count.

excluded.name: Barrick Gold
excluded.reason: Large-cap gold miner; operational complexity, Zambia political risk, and streaming companies (FNV, WPM) provide cleaner gold exposure with zero capex risk. Streaming structure preferred over mining equity at gold ATH.

excluded.name: Newmont Corporation
excluded.reason: World's largest gold miner; integration complexity after Newcrest acquisition, cost overruns, and operational issues. Streaming companies preferred for gold exposure. Mine-level operational risk not justified when FNV/WPM available.

excluded.name: BHP Group
excluded.reason: Similar to RIO: diversified miner with large iron ore and coal exposure. Copper is growing but not the primary revenue driver. Prefer pure-play or high-torque copper exposure (FCX, SCCO) over blended mega-miners.

excluded.name: ExxonMobil
excluded.reason: Large-cap integrated major; limited torque to specific HA themes. Valero (refining crack spreads), Tidewater (offshore vessels), and Scorpio (tanker tonne-miles) provide higher torque to specific oil theses without mega-cap dilution.

excluded.name: Lithium Americas
excluded.reason: Thacker Pass development is important but DoD funding uncertainty and regulatory timeline risk make entry timing difficult. Pre-production; construction capex risk. ALB and SQM preferred for near-term trough positioning with production optionality.

excluded.name: Livent (now Arcadium)
excluded.reason: Merged into Arcadium; Rio Tinto acquisition announced 2024. Effectively removed as a standalone vehicle. Rio Tinto integration means exposure comes via diversified miner — excluded for same reasons as RIO.

excluded.name: Arafura Rare Earths
excluded.reason: Australian HREE developer (Nolans project — primarily neodymium, praseodymium). Pre-production; no clear near-term offtake certainty. LYC.AX preferred as operating company with proven separation; Arafura adds development-stage risk.

excluded.name: Schlumberger (SLB)
excluded.reason: Oil services; revenue tied to E&P capex cycle. HA thesis favors asset holders (refining, tankers, vessels) over services. SLB's exposure is E&P spending decisions — more cyclical, less thesis-specific than TDW/STNG/VLO.

excluded.name: Syrah Resources
excluded.reason: Balama graphite plus the Vidalia US anode plant was the obvious graphite fix. Yahoo returns no price data as of 2026-08-05, consistent with the 2025 administration process. Excluded as un-investable until the situation resolves; the graphite gap therefore stays open rather than being papered over.

excluded.name: TMC the metals company
excluded.reason: Deep-sea polymetallic nodules would close nickel, cobalt and manganese at once. Excluded on regulatory grounds: commercial recovery still lacks an ISA exploitation framework, so this is a permitting bet rather than a supply asset.

excluded.name: Piedmont Lithium
excluded.reason: No longer resolves as a standalone ticker following the Sayona combination. Not re-added under a new symbol pending confirmation of the surviving entity.

excluded.name: Capstone Holding Corp
excluded.reason: Not the company intended. CAPS is a building materials distributor. The microturbine business trades as CGEH (Capstone Energy+, OTC Pink) and is now IN the universe. Recorded so the wrong ticker is not picked up again.
